Prepare Alpine Linux for the generic GRUB targets.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value        |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Priority     | `0`          |
| Dependencies | `rugix-ctrl` |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Installs the LTS kernel and mkinitfs configuration, copies the kernel and initrd
into the boot tree, and installs the second-stage GRUB configuration. Select a
compatible generic GRUB target when assembling the system.

The custom mkinitfs feature supplies a mount implementation that resolves
PARTUUID device references, as required by Rugix Ctrl.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/alpine-grub-setup"]
```
